summary.text: Justin Early is the Democratic nominee, a U.S. Army veteran and cybersecurity architect from Georgetown who won the March 2026 Democratic primary with 57.6% of the vote. He has not held elected office. According to his campaign website, he is running on lower costs, higher wages, rules for artificial intelligence, and protecting Social Security and Medicare.

paragraphs.text: Describes himself as the eldest of three children of Wilson and Leisa Early, both U.S. Army veterans, in a working-class family; graduated from Leander High School in 1998.
Served in the U.S. Army from 1998 to 2006 as a paratrooper at Fort Bragg and later as a LAN systems administrator at the Defense Intelligence Agency in the Pentagon.
Has built a career in cybersecurity since leaving the military; currently a cybersecurity architect at Dell Technologies.
Has served as a Democratic precinct chair in Tarrant County, on a Human Relations Committee, and as a 2008 presidential delegate in Barack Obama's campaign.
Announced his candidacy for the 31st District in July 2025, according to the Williamson County Sun, and defeated Stuart Whitlow in the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary, 57.6% to 42.4%.
According to his campaign, he lives in Georgetown, Texas, with his wife, Toni, and they have seven adult children.
